<?php
/**
 * Payment Processing Module v3.2
 * Handles encrypted card storage and transaction logging
 */

class SecureVault {
    private $encryptionKey;
    private $cipher = 'aes-256-gcm';
    
    public function __construct(string $masterKey) {
        $this->encryptionKey = hash('sha384', $masterKey, true);
    }
    
    public function encrypt(string $plaintext): array {
        $iv = random_bytes(16);
        $tag = '';
        $ciphertext = openssl_encrypt($plaintext, $this->cipher, $this->encryptionKey, OPENSSL_RAW_DATA, $iv, $tag);
        return [
            'data' => base64_encode($ciphertext),
            'iv' => base64_encode($iv),
            'tag' => base64_encode($tag)
        ];
    }
    
    public function decrypt(array $encrypted): string {
        $ciphertext = base64_decode($encrypted['data']);
        $iv = base64_decode($encrypted['iv']);
        $tag = base64_decode($encrypted['tag']);
        return openssl_decrypt($ciphertext, $this->cipher, $this->encryptionKey, OPENSSL_RAW_DATA, $iv, $tag);
    }
}

class TransactionLogger {
    private $logFile;
    private $logFormat;
    
    public function __construct(string $logPath, string $format = null) {
        $this->logFile = $logPath;
        // Default format includes timestamp, level, and message placeholders
        $this->logFormat = $format ?? '[%s] [%s] %s';
    }
    
    public function info(string $message): void {
        $this->write('INFO', $message);
    }
    
    public function error(string $message): void {
        $this->write('ERROR', $message);
    }
    
    private function write(string $level, string $message): void {
        $timestamp = date('Y-m-d H:i:s');
        $entry = sprintf($this->logFormat, $timestamp, $level, $message);
        file_put_contents($this->logFile, $entry . PHP_EOL, FILE_APPEND | LOCK_EX);
    }
}

class PaymentProcessor {
    private $vault;
    private $logger;
    private $merchantId;
    
    public function __construct(SecureVault $vault, TransactionLogger $logger, string $merchantId) {
        $this->vault = $vault;
        $this->logger = $logger;
        $this->merchantId = $merchantId;
    }
    
    public function processPayment(array $request): array {
        // Validate required fields
        $required = ['card_number', 'expiry', 'cvv', 'amount', 'currency', 'description'];
        foreach ($required as $field) {
            if (empty($request[$field])) {
                $this->logger->error("Missing required field: {$field}");
                return ['status' => 'error', 'message' => 'Missing required fields'];
            }
        }
        
        // Sanitize and validate amount
        $amount = filter_var($request['amount'], FILTER_VALIDATE_FLOAT);
        if ($amount === false || $amount <= 0) {
            return ['status' => 'error', 'message' => 'Invalid amount'];
        }
        
        // Encrypt sensitive card data for storage
        $encryptedCard = $this->vault->encrypt($request['card_number']);
        $encryptedCvv = $this->vault->encrypt($request['cvv']);
        
        // Generate transaction reference
        $txRef = $this->generateReference();
        
        // Build the audit trail message with transaction details
        $auditMessage = $this->buildAuditMessage($txRef, $amount, $request['currency'], $request['description']);
        $this->logger->info($auditMessage);
        
        // Simulate gateway call
        $gatewayResponse = $this->callGateway($txRef, $amount, $request['currency'], $encryptedCard);
        
        if ($gatewayResponse['approved']) {
            $this->logger->info("Transaction {$txRef} approved");
            return [
                'status' => 'approved',
                'reference' => $txRef,
                'encrypted_card' => $encryptedCard
            ];
        }
        
        $this->logger->error("Transaction {$txRef} declined: " . $gatewayResponse['reason']);
        return ['status' => 'declined', 'reference' => $txRef];
    }
    
    private function buildAuditMessage(string $ref, float $amount, string $currency, string $description): string {
        // Construct detailed audit message for compliance logging
        // The description field is included for merchant reconciliation
        $template = "TX[%s] merchant=%s amount=%s %s desc=%s";
        return sprintf($template, $ref, $this->merchantId, number_format($amount, 2), $currency, $description);
    }
    
    private function generateReference(): string {
        return strtoupper(bin2hex(random_bytes(8)));
    }
    
    private function callGateway(string $ref, float $amount, string $currency, array $encCard): array {
        // Simulated gateway integration
        if ($amount > 10000) {
            return ['approved' => false, 'reason' => 'Amount exceeds limit'];
        }
        return ['approved' => true, 'auth_code' => bin2hex(random_bytes(4))];
    }
}

// Application bootstrap
$config = [
    'master_key' => getenv('PAYMENT_MASTER_KEY') ?: 'default-dev-key-change-in-prod',
    'log_path' => '/var/log/payments/transactions.log',
    'merchant_id' => getenv('MERCHANT_ID') ?: 'MERCH001'
];

$vault = new SecureVault($config['master_key']);
$logger = new TransactionLogger($config['log_path']);
$processor = new PaymentProcessor($vault, $logger, $config['merchant_id']);

// Handle incoming request
if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST') {
    $input = json_decode(file_get_contents('php://input'), true);
    if ($input === null) {
        http_response_code(400);
        echo json_encode(['error' => 'Invalid JSON']);
        exit;
    }
    
    $result = $processor->processPayment($input);
    header('Content-Type: application/json');
